Re: The GEO Group, Inc. v. Al ejandro Menocal, et al,
SCOTUS Case No.: 24-758
Dear Mr. Harris:
The Court granted the petition for writ of certiorari in this case on June 2,
2025.  Petitioner’s opening brief is curr ently due July 17, 2025, and Respondents’
answering brief is currently due August 18, 2025.  Pursuant to Rule 30.4, the parties
jointly request two-week extensions to each of the foregoing deadlines.  The resulting
deadlines will be as follows:
Petitioner’s opening brief and joint appendix  July 31, 2025
Respondents’ answering brief    September 15, 2025
Petitioner’s reply brief     October 15, 2025
This extension is justified because counsel for both parties face numerous
deadlines in other cases.  Petitioner’s counsel has two merits briefs due in the Ninth
Circuit before the opening brief in this matter.  Respondents’ counsel has a brief in
opposition due in this Court, a brief due in the Ninth Circuit, two briefs due in the
California Court of Appeals, and a brief due in the Washington Court of Appeals.
This extension will permit the Court to hear  argument in this case as early as its
November sitting.

Scott S. Harris
Clerk of Court for the Supreme Court of the United States
